term.savingsAccount.name: Savings account
term.savingsAccount.simple: A bank account that keeps your money safe and pays a little interest.
term.savingsAccount.life: Your gift money sits in the bank instead of a drawer.
term.savingsAccount.real: Savings account = a bank account for keeping money you do not need today. It pays interest and lets you withdraw.
term.kyc.name: KYC
term.kyc.simple: The bank checking who you are.
term.kyc.life: Showing your identity and address documents to open an account.
term.kyc.real: KYC = Know Your Customer: the identity and address check a bank must do before it opens an account.
term.nominee.name: Nominee
term.nominee.simple: The person who gets your money if something happens to you.
term.nominee.life: A student names her mother as the nominee on her account.
term.nominee.real: Nominee = the person named to receive the money in an account or policy if the holder dies.
term.interest.name: Interest
term.interest.simple: Money paid for the use of money.
term.interest.life: ₹3,000 in a savings account at 3% a year earns about ₹7.50 in a month.
term.interest.real: Interest = the amount paid for using money. A bank pays it to savers and charges it to borrowers.
term.dicgc.name: DICGC
term.dicgc.simple: The body that insures bank deposits in India.
term.dicgc.life: If a bank fails, depositors are paid back up to a limit.
term.dicgc.real: DICGC = Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation. It insures bank deposits up to a limit set by law.
term.statement.name: Statement
term.statement.simple: The list of every rupee that came into and went out of your account.
term.ifsc.name: IFSC
term.ifsc.simple: The code that identifies a bank branch. Others need it to send you money.
term.minimumBalance.name: Minimum balance
term.minimumBalance.simple: The least you must keep in an account to avoid a charge.
term.debitCard.name: Debit card
term.debitCard.simple: A card that spends your own money.
term.debitCard.life: You pay ₹200 at a shop and ₹200 leaves your account at once.
term.debitCard.real: Debit card = a card that pays straight from your bank balance.
term.creditCard.name: Credit card
term.creditCard.simple: A card that spends the bank's money, which you repay.
term.creditCard.life: You pay ₹200 at a shop today and repay the bank when the bill comes.
term.creditCard.real: Credit card = a card that lets you borrow from the bank up to a limit and repay later.
term.upi.name: UPI
term.upi.simple: A way to send money from one bank account to another by phone.
term.upi.life: Paying the canteen by scanning its QR code.
term.upi.real: UPI = Unified Payments Interface: a system for instant bank-to-bank payments by phone.
term.upiPin.name: UPI PIN
term.upiPin.simple: The secret number that approves a payment you send.
term.upiPin.life: You type it after checking the name and the amount.
term.upiPin.real: UPI PIN = the secret code that authorises a UPI payment. It is needed only to send money, never to receive it.
term.otp.name: OTP
term.otp.simple: A one-time code sent to your phone.
term.otp.life: A six-digit code arrives when you log in or pay.
term.otp.real: OTP = One-Time Password: a code that approves one action. It must never be shared.
term.cvv.name: CVV
term.cvv.simple: The three-digit code on the back of a card. Never share it.
term.collectRequest.name: Collect request
term.collectRequest.simple: A request asking you to pay. Approving it with your PIN sends money out.
